title: infra-vocabulary
description: The infrastructure routing vocabulary: the bead types and labels that mark an infrastructure Task. This file is the one definition of the contract and the only place its values are written. skills/artifact-handoff/scripts/infra_vocabulary.py is generated from it by scripts/gen_infra_vocabulary.py, and scripts/check_infra_vocabulary.py fails when that module is stale. Consumers strip and lower-case a bead's type and labels, match the type against types and the labels against labels, and count every infrastructure type as a known type, so a label marks an infrastructure Task only when the bead's type is not a known type.

types.description: The bead types that mark an infrastructure Task.

labels.description: The bead labels that mark an infrastructure Task when the bead's type is not a known type.

carrierKey.description: The workflow argument (route-build, task-to-deploy) under which the whole object is passed unchanged.
